name: AK13B - App-Connected Breathalyser & Alcohol Tester (Breath Alcohol), Bluetooth, 99-Record Memory
highlights: The Reading Goes to a Phone — Bluetooth pairing sends each result to a handset — timestamped, stored and shareable. A number on a device screen is a moment; a record on a phone is evidence.
Same Ten-Second Warm-Up, Six-Second Blow — Identical test cycle and sensing to AK13A, with the record-keeping moved off the device.
Why Fleets Ask for It — A driver can send a pre-shift result to a supervisor without either of them being in the same place. That is a workflow the standalone version cannot support.
150 mAh, USB-C — About an hour to charge, 53 g.
Same Body and Carton as AK13A — 100 per box, 195,000 per 20 ft container — the connected version costs nothing extra in freight.
